# BoundlessCAD

> BoundlessCAD is a remote exocad dental CAD design studio. It designs crowns, bridges, veneers, inlays/onlays, implant crowns, custom abutments, full-arch implant prostheses (All-on-4 / All-on-6), night guards / occlusal splints and surgical guides for dental laboratories and digital clinics worldwide, and returns production-ready STL files plus the exocad project in 24–48 hours. The first case is designed free.

Key facts:
- Service: outsourced / remote dental CAD design in exocad DentalCAD for dental labs and clinics (white-label).
- Turnaround: 24–48 hours for standard crowns and bridges; full-arch and guide cases scheduled on agreement.
- Pricing (per unit, USD): crowns, copings, veneers and bridge units $6.40; implant crowns and custom abutments $9.10; full-arch implant prosthesis $88 per arch; night guards / splints $12; surgical guides from $86.50. Volume pricing for labs sending 100+ units a month.
- First case: free, so a lab can judge quality on a real job.
- Overnight option: crowns and bridges received by 18:00 (lab's local time) can be ready by 08:00 next morning; full-arch and guides scheduled per case.
- Monthly Design Seat plans (USD): Seat 50 = $290 (50 credits, $5.80/unit), Seat 100 = $549 (100 credits, $5.49/unit), Seat 250 = $1,290 (250 credits, $5.16/unit). 1 credit = 1 crown/bridge unit; implant crown or custom abutment = 1.5; night guard = 2; full-arch = 14 per arch; unused credits roll over one month; cancel anytime.
- Free design review: labs can send one of their own exocad designs for a free written check of margins, contacts, occlusion, thickness and connectors (48 h).
- Referral program: when a referred lab places its first paid order, both labs get 10 free design credits.
- Files accepted: intraoral or model scans as STL or PLY, or a complete exocad project, plus a prescription (teeth, restoration type, material, shade; for implants: system, platform and scan body).
- Delivered: production-ready STL files and the exocad project; revisions included until approved; the lab's own design parameters (cement gap, minimum thickness, connectors, tooth library) are followed.
- Privacy: anonymized files under a case code only, never patient names.
- Languages: English and Spanish.
- Contact: boundlesscad.design@gmail.com · Instagram @boundless.cad

## Pages
- [Home (English)](https://boundlesscaddesign-dev.github.io/): services, how it works, pricing, portfolio, FAQ
- [Inicio (Español)](https://boundlesscaddesign-dev.github.io/es/): the same site in Spanish
- [3D case library](https://boundlesscaddesign-dev.github.io/cases/): real exocad designs that open in 3D in the browser (single crowns, bridges, implant bridges, full-arch implant cases)
- [Send a case](https://boundlesscaddesign-dev.github.io/send/): which files to send, a digital prescription with FDI tooth chart, and how to share large scans
- [Design Seat plans](https://boundlesscaddesign-dev.github.io/plans/): monthly plans and how credits work
- [Free design review](https://boundlesscaddesign-dev.github.io/review/): free second-opinion check of a lab's own design
- [Refer a lab](https://boundlesscaddesign-dev.github.io/refer/): referral program, 10 free credits each
- [Guide: outsourcing exocad design](https://boundlesscaddesign-dev.github.io/guide/): how remote dental CAD design works, what it costs, what to send, how to judge a design studio

## For milling centres
- White-label design partner program (design + milling under the centre's own brand, overnight, margin calculator): https://boundlesscaddesign-dev.github.io/partner/

- More services (quoted per case): https://boundlesscaddesign-dev.github.io/services/ — removable dentures, implant bars, smile design, print models, STL repair.
- Free STL Check (in-browser, nothing uploaded): https://boundlesscaddesign-dev.github.io/check/ — finds holes, non-manifold edges, flipped normals, debris and unit errors in dental STL/PLY scans.
- STL Check in Spanish: https://boundlesscaddesign-dev.github.io/check/es/ · in German: https://boundlesscaddesign-dev.github.io/check/de/

- [Margin Master](https://boundlesscaddesign-dev.github.io/margin/): free 3D game for dental technicians — trace the margin line on three preparations, accuracy scored in microns.
